task.summary: Default task
First commit
Functionality from PoC added
Quality parameters (GD, Spread) and solution set monitoring added. Algorithm parameters table sketch added.
Algorithm parameters editing added
Algorithm parameters settings added. Classes for different cell factory depending on the data inside the cell added.
Setting algorithm parameters from UI done
Binding and validation algorithm parameters fixed. Stopping algorithm added. Disabling/enabling controls on start/stop added.
Algorithm execution info added
Setting controls on application start added. Settings controls when algorithm finishes added.

Added DBSPEA2 algorithm. Changed all 2D charts to jfreechart. Added Orson 3D chart. Added showing reference Pareto front. Added IGD quality indicator. Now controls are updated only in active tab. Optimized GUI updates. Some warning resloved.
Added lock when changing tab. Added some refactorings.
Refactorings due to GUI throttling (stable version). Fixed some warnings.
Added zooming 3D charts.
Added remaining QIs (IGD+, Epsilon, HV, Error ratio). Complemented IGD. Added turning on/off computing and showing QIs through checkboxes.
Added showing on/off reference Pareto Front.
Fixed charts and solution set descriptions.
Added setting algorithm and problem at app start.
Added problems. Added justifying chart to max and min values during chart refreshing.
Added alpha-SPEA2.
Added modified SPEA2 and NSGA-II algorithms. Added turing on/off showing of ref. PF and additional ref points.
Added algorithm-related functionality.
Added dynamic tab managing and nMOEA + nMOEAAlpha algorithms.
Added parallel coordinates chart fro problems with objective count > 3.
Added normalizing front befor computing qi-s.
Changed killing long-running thread method.
Updated picking many-objective DTLZ problem mechanism.
Added EpsilonBoxMOEA. Fixed picking DTLZ problems.
Added dynamic resizing to solution set table view.
Changed axes properties of parallel coordinates chart.
Added resetting 2D charts on mouse double-click.
Added unification of quality indicators value format.
Added step-by-step execution mode.
Added 'select all'/'select none' option to QIs. Merged choosing QIs with showing QIs values and moved to right pane. Rearranged right pane.
Updated setting maxIterations count for NSGA-II (and derivatives) due to final solutions count.
Unified shapes and colors of all charts (2d, 3d, PC). Hided showing "ref" points. Added granularity of X axis of QI charts as integers.
Added custom legend do PC chart.
Changed font of legend and axes of 3D chart.
Added monitoring solution count.
Added problem description. Rearranged controls (moved algorithm and porblem choice from left to right, moved charts options to bottom). Updated legends strings.
Changed scroll behaviour on 3D chart.
Rearranged chart options on BorderPane.
Adjusted UI to changes of main window size.
Added progress bar. Changed "iteration" to "evaluation".
